findings.body: The new evidence not covered by the earlier coordinate-materialization ruling is the `otherDimensions.length === 1` guard: explicitly selected values are added only when month is grouped with exactly one other dimension. With `plant + cost_center + month`, bases come exclusively from facts already returned by the repository. Consequently, a catalog-valid selected Plant/Cost-Center pair with no facts anywhere in the period produces no monthly rows at all, even when coverage confirms zero or should expose a missing-data gap. This avoids the former Cartesian fan-out but still fails the requirement to retain all valid catalog combinations; the repository must supply valid catalog coordinates rather than relying solely on observed facts.
findings.title: Not done: exact factual answers without guessed dimension combinations

findings.body: The only multi-dimensional completion case supplies both valid Plant/Cost-Center bases as already-observed coordinates. The repository regression test covers only one non-month dimension (`gl`). Therefore the suite remains green while `FinancialQueryRepository` drops a catalog-valid multi-dimensional selection that has no facts in any requested month. A repository-level test must select such a valid combination and verify its rows and states across covered and outside/noncontinuous source months.
findings.title: Not done: catalog-valid empty-coordinate repository trend test

findings.body: The positive closing-balance assertion calls `sumClosingMonthRollover` directly. The only subsequent repository assertion uses a database where the closing month is not loaded, so execution returns `not_loaded` without exercising the new available Roll-over summation branch. This test would still pass if the repository reverted to summing every period month's stored Roll-over. The required proof must query `FinancialQueryRepository` with both earlier and closing-month budget facts and assert that only the closing month's stored balances are returned.
findings.title: Not done: stored closing Roll-over repository test
